cannot_imply: All analytic claims are solver proof candidates; no independent-verifier receipt or formal build.
Pair-center separation or bounded local occupancy is an explicit hypothesis, not extracted from the signed defect.
The covered-pair bound leaves the hole mass H_R explicit; the genuine example refutes automatic H_R=o(N) from the one-scale hypotheses.
The hole example is a genuine finite exponential multiset, not actual zeta zeros. Its long budget holds only asymptotically and it violates the fixed shorter-scale budget.
No general decomposition into homogeneous hole phases, actual arithmetic D=o(N), weighted-to-unweighted/profile transfer, or completed two-scale error budget.
Multiplicity deletion cost does not imply small discarded Hilbert-Schmidt operator energy.
No unconditional zeta-zero proportion, RH proof/refutation, or literature-wide novelty claim.
No full repository CI, bundled inventory/record runner or upstream Lean build; only package-local structure/hash checks and bounded computation.
Gauss-Legendre and mpmath quadrature are not interval certificates; numerical tests do not prove all-size statements.
